extras: Includes a reusable skill source for ChatGPT integration.
intentEvidence: Tasknotes-PM balances the active project groups across the color wheel once, then preserves their saved hues while assigning new projects the most distinct available color.
problem: Managing complex project timelines and visually distinguishing project cards within TaskNotes Kanban views.

relations.evidence: Tasknotes-PM is an Obsidian companion plugin for TaskNotes.
This replaces the need for the separate TaskNotes Project Colors plugin.

summary: Project scheduling and visual styling companion for TaskNotes, discovering project hierarchies and managing finish-to-start dependencies.
